title: GCN: GM confirms all 12 of its 2027 model-year EVs will ship with native NACS charging ports
notes: For 2026 most GM EVs keep a CCS1 port and need the GM NACS DC adapter; only the Cadillac Optiq and Chevrolet Bolt are NACS-native for 2026. All 2027 EVs, including Blazer EV, Silverado EV and Lyriq, get native NACS.
